trips.name: Motor train
trips.note: Through train: No. 71 Arborfield - Crooked River; No. 71 Crooked River - North Battleford. Arborfield 4.45 a.m. marked e (Wednesday and Friday); continues from Crooked River 5.35 a.m. in Table 180 (motor column 77-71-75) to Prince Albert and North Battleford. Shown in Pacific time: two hours earlier than the Central time printed, an hour earlier than the Mountain time.
